name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Marketing Communications Specialist role. What draws me to it is the ownership: one person running website content, SEO, email, and communications end to end for an organization people rely on to get around the northwest metro. That's the same shape of work I do now, hands-on, not delegated.

A few things line up directly. I maintain client websites and run technical SEO audits and keyword research myself, keeping content accurate and aligned with search performance. I build and send segmented email campaigns and newsletters and track results in GA4, then turn that into monthly reporting a director can act on without translation. And I write the copy myself: direct-response content, campaign copy, and recurring newsletter and thought-leadership pieces.

I don't have WordPress or Meta Ads by name, or a background in transportation or nonprofit work, and I'd rather say that directly than have it surface later. What I bring instead is genuine hands-on execution across the channels this role owns, and a track record of being the person who keeps a small organization's communications running day to day.
